project_type: Browser extension (MV3), MIT-licensed fork of 'Authenticator'. Vue 2 (2.7) + TypeScript + Vuex 3, bundled with Webpack 5.
build_system: Webpack 5 via webpack-cli. Build orchestrated by bash scripts/build.sh, but webpack/tsc/eslint/prettier all run via node and can be invoked directly without bash. Type checking is done by fork-ts-checker-webpack-plugin during the webpack build (ts-loader runs transpileOnly). Direct `tsc --noEmit` is NOT reliable here because tsconfig includes .vue/.svg imports that plain tsc cannot resolve.
build_command: From worktree root (bash-free, Windows-friendly): `npx webpack --config ./webpack.config.js` (compiles all entries + type-checks .ts/.vue via ForkTsCheckerWebpackPlugin, emits to dist/). This is what `bash scripts/build.sh chrome` runs for compilation.
test_command: Tests run via Puppeteer: `node scripts/test-runner.js` after a `test` webpack build (`bash scripts/build.sh test`). The runner launches non-headless Chrome and navigates to a HARDCODED original extension id URL (chrome-extension://bhghoamapcdpbohphigoooaddinpkbai/view/test.html), so it is brittle/likely-unrunnable on Windows. Mocha+Chai+@vue/test-utils+sinon-chrome. The `src/test` require.context in src/test.ts auto-discovers every *.ts under src/test, so new *.test.ts files need NO wiring. Minimum bar: confirm new test files COMPILE in the webpack `test` build.
verification_instructions: 1) `npx webpack --config ./webpack.config.js` -> expect successful build, zero TS errors from fork-ts-checker. 2) `npx eslint . --ext .js,.ts` -> expect no errors. 3) `npx prettier --check <changed files>` -> expect all pass (run --write then re-check if diffs). Report exact commands and their output; do not claim success on 'no errors' alone. 4) If Puppeteer+Chrome available, build the test bundle and run `node scripts/test-runner.js`; otherwise state it cannot run on Windows and rely on compile.
snapshot_or_generated_files: null — no generated files are checked into the repo for these changes. Build output goes to dist/ (gitignored).
environment_constraints: User is on Windows (PowerShell). All npm run scripts (chrome/firefox/edge/prod/pretest/compile) invoke bash and will fail without Git Bash/WSL. Invoke webpack/eslint/prettier directly via npx instead. Puppeteer test runner is non-headless and uses a hardcoded extension id; treat as optional/unavailable on Windows. Do NOT run the broken webpack.watch.js (needs webpack-extension-reloader, unsupported on webpack 5).
contribution_requirements: Preserve MIT LICENSE and copyright/permission notice. Do NOT rebrand (extName/extShortName/extDesc in _locales, icons, manifest, oauth client_id). Do NOT touch scripts/credentials.ts or cloud-backup credentials. build.sh prints a fork notice but it is non-blocking for non-prod; the direct webpack command skips it entirely. Keep chrome.storage.sync payloads small.
key_patterns: The `pinned` field is the exact template for the new `folder` field. (a) otp.d.ts: `pinned?: boolean` on OTPEntryInterface and RawOTPStorage. (b) models/otp.ts: class prop + constructor default via `if (entry.pinned) this.pinned = entry.pinned; else this.pinned = false;` and in applyEncryption `this.pinned = decryptedData.pinned || false;`. (c) models/storage.ts getOTPStorageFromEntry: write-only-when-set `if (entry.pinned) storageItem.pinned = true;`; EntryStorage.get reads back `pinned: entryData.pinned` in the `new OTPEntry({...})`; import maps `pinned: data[hash].pinned || false`; backupGetExport does `delete entry.pinned;` (we deliberately do NOT delete folder, so backups round-trip). (d) store/Accounts.ts mutation `pinEntry(state, entry) { state.entries[entry.index].pinned = !entry.pinned; }`; component persists via commit then `await EntryStorage.set(this.$store.state.accounts.entries)` (see EntryComponent.vue `pin()` + MainBody.vue dropModel). (e) i18n: _locales/en/messages.json entries are `{ "message": "...", "description": "..." }`; components read strings via `this.i18n.<key>` injected on Vue prototype (loadI18nMessages in store/i18n.ts). (f) Vuex state shapes are declared as ambient interfaces in src/definitions/module-interface.d.ts (StyleState, AccountsState) — adding store state requires updating the matching interface there. (g) Default string fields default to "" (see issuer/account in otp.ts).
